snippet.title: Alabaster Dawn - Early Access Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Alabaster Dawn: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110760

Alabaster Dawn is an Action RPG building on top of the best aspects of Radical Fish Games' previous title CrossCode, featuring a deep and engaging combat system, challenging puzzles and an epic story set in a curious world full of secrets to discover and places to explore. The shadow of Nyx has fallen, warping the world into a wasteland and vanishing the gods and their people. Now, Juno, the Outcast Chosen, awakens to an impossible task: bring it all back. The new trailer showcases new content, including new boss fights, story sequences and locations. Alabaster Dawn Early Access launches on May 7th, 2026.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
